_doc: Human/AI-in-the-loop judgement overrides (ground rule: distorted data is handled per ticker, never by changing the general formula). Committed to git so they survive database resets; database overrides (UI / API / CLI) layer on top. Every key and its meaning: `python -m vmi.overrides schema` (declared in vmi/overrides.py). Edit with `python -m vmi.overrides set TICKER key=value --note '...' --commit`. Always give a `note` explaining why.

TMO.note: Consensus temporarily distorted very low after the post-COVID normalisation; Adam kept the prior long-term rate (heavenly-queen compounder). Use ~13% long-run EPS growth (pre-distortion consensus band 12-15%). Force DCF on FCF (Adam's method for TMO) instead of the P/S fallback the selector picks when the distorted data breaks consistency. | AI moat review (Claude, 2026-11-05; general knowledge + Step-3 evidence — please verify): scale distributor/manufacturer; validated consumables are sticky in regulated labs

ASML.note: 5y EPS estimates (FinViz 42%, Zacks 52%) look like a cyclical rebound off a depressed base and hit the 40% cap; next-year estimates are ~34-38%. Normalised to 20% (judgement; revisit when consensus settles). | AI moat review (Claude, 2026-11-05; general knowledge + Step-3 evidence — please verify): EUV lithography monopoly; decades of IP and supplier ecosystem

AVGO.note: FinViz 5y EPS 65% (next-year ~62-67%) reflects the current AI ramp; not plausible as a 5-year average at this scale. Normalised to 25% (judgement). | AI moat review (Claude, 2026-11-05; general knowledge + Step-3 evidence — please verify): custom silicon/networking IP, VMware lock-in

VEEV.note: Sources disagree (FinViz 12.5%, Zacks 35%). Since 2026-11-05 the default lowest source applies; the earlier 18% judgement was removed because it pushed the IV further above Adam's. | AI moat review (Claude, 2026-11-05; general knowledge + Step-3 evidence — please verify): validated, regulated life-sciences cloud is costly to replace

PLTR.note: Now consistently FCF-positive with rising FCF; Adam values it on DCF rather than PSG. Speculative sizing still applies. | AI moat review (Claude, 2026-11-05; general knowledge + Step-3 evidence — please verify): security clearances and embedded government/enterprise deployments (Adam: very strong)

ACGL.note: Specialty (re)insurer: book value compounding is the value driver; Adam's IV (109.38) matches P/B valuation (108.4). DNI overstates because float-driven earnings are lumpy. | AI moat review (Claude, 2026-11-05; general knowledge + Step-3 evidence — please verify): underwriting discipline and specialty scale; insurance moats are thin (Adam holds it)

UNH.note: Managed care is a cash-flow business (Adam values it by DCF). The 2025-26 medical-cost shock dented CFO, which fails strict consistency and pushes the selector to the P/S reference; use DCF on FCF. Growth stays automatic (lowest source). | AI moat review (Claude, 2026-11-05; general knowledge + Step-3 evidence — please verify): scale in managed care, Optum provider network, regulation (Adam: market leader)
